title.narrative: Strengthening the national strategy for comprehensive and focalized interventions to achieve Malaria Elimination in Honduras, 2018-2020 - Honduras (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Honduras, Malaria, GLOBAL COMMUNITIES, INC. (GC Honduras)This program has the following goals: Zero indigenous malaria cases registered by 2020. The objectives of this program are: To promote integrated vector management. To strengthen the epidemiological strategy for malaria differentiated by strata and maintaining control of the emergence of outbreaks. To strengthen the coverage and quality of malaria diagnosis and treatment services. To strengthen the role of the Health System including the community role
